title: Best Website Content Writers (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire a website content writer: what the package should include, how to brief each page, what drives the price and red flags.
intro: Website content is the text on your home, about, services and contact pages. It has to explain what you do, build trust and help visitors take the next step, while also being found in search. Website projects often stall waiting for this text. Ordering it early, with a clear brief, keeps the whole site on schedule.

faq.q: Should the content be written before the design?
faq.a: Ideally, yes, or at least at the same time. Designers work better with real text, and pages built around placeholder text often need reworking when the real words arrive.

faq.q: Will the writer optimize for search?
faq.a: Ask. Many website writers include basic search optimization: page titles, meta descriptions, headings and the main phrases customers use. Give them your target phrases if you have them.

faq.q: How much text does each page need?
faq.a: Enough to answer the visitor's questions for that page. Service pages usually need more detail than a contact page. A good writer will suggest lengths based on the page's purpose.

faq.q: Can the writer match my brand voice?
faq.a: Yes, if you explain it. Share examples of writing you like, words you use and avoid, and how formal you want to sound.
